cta.heading: Discuss a Technology Modelling Need
cta.primary: Talk to our team about a technology, dataset or repeatable analytical tool that should be represented transparently in energy system planning.
cta.secondary: or check the relevant services curated for you on your right* adjust secondary CTA here.

system-operators-and-utilities.title: System Operators and Utilities
paragraphs: Use open-source tools for complex planning workflows while meeting institutional requirements for security, reliability, performance and integration.
We support model and data development, software deployment, validation, benchmarking, training, maintenance and ongoing technical support.

link.label: Explore services for System Operators and Utilities

regulators-and-public-authorities.title: Regulators and Public Authorities
paragraphs: Build independent and transparent analytical capabilities for energy policy, regulation and infrastructure assessment.
We help public institutions select and adopt appropriate tools, establish reliable data and modelling workflows, train internal teams and assess plans using reproducible methods.

link.label: Explore services for Regulators and Public Authorities

consultancies-and-engineering-firms.title: Consultancies and Engineering Firms
paragraphs: Add specialist open-source modelling, software and data capabilities to your client offer.
We work as a technical partner on bids and projects, provide advanced modelling and software development, and help consulting teams build their own capacity to support open-source tools.

link.label: Explore services for Consultancies and Engineering Firms

foundations-and-development-partners.title: Foundations and Development Partners
paragraphs: Strengthen the shared tools, data and institutional capacity needed for transparent energy planning to spread.
We design and deliver programmes that improve open-source infrastructure, close data and software gaps, support adoption by influential institutions and develop local delivery ecosystems.

link.label: Explore services for Foundations and Development Partners

think-tanks-ngos-and-research-organizati.title: Think Tanks, NGOs and Research Orgs.
paragraphs: Develop credible open models, datasets and analytical workflows that can be scrutinised, reused and maintained.
We support tool development, applied modelling, data infrastructure, quality assurance, training and strategies for publishing and sustaining open-source work.

link.label: Explore services for Think Tanks, NGOs and Research Orgs.

technology-developers-and-investors.title: Technology Developers and Investors
paragraphs: Apply transparent energy system modelling to investment or design questions.

We develop transparent methods, datasets and tools to assess system value, infrastructure requirements and performance under future scenarios, working alongside commercial advisors where broader project or investment analysis is required.

link.label: Explore services for Technology Developers and Investors

testimonials.heading: Partners & Clients Testimonials
testimonials.subline: Don't just listen to us. This is what our partners and clients say

items.quote: “I particularly appreciated the hands-on structure that allowed us to actively apply PyPSA in realistic modelling scenarios.”
items.name: Ntathu Masimula
paragraphs: The workshop exceeded my expectations in both content and delivery. I particularly appreciated the hands-on structure that allowed us to actively apply PyPSA in realistic modelling scenarios.
The facilitation team created a collaborative environment where technical professionals and market analysts could learn from each other, something I found both rare and highly enriching.

The training made a compelling case for using open-source modelling in African contexts especially where resource constraints limit access to commercial software. I was particularly inspired by the transparency and replicability that open-source platforms like PyPSA offer.
